description_en: Queries the details of feature definitions in the published Thing Specification Language model of a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口查看指定产品的已发布物模型中的功能定义详情
name: QueryThingModelPublished

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no<props="intl"><ph> Overview page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

This parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

目前不传入此参数
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The version number of the Thing Specification Language model.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150318.html to view the Thing Specification Language model version numbers of a product.

If you leave this parameter empty, the latest published version is returned
parameters.help_zh:
物模型版本号。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150318.html查看产品下的物模型版本号。

为空时返回已发布的最新版本
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the custom module in the Thing Specification Language model. The identifier is unique within the product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the data of the default module is queried
parameters.help_zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。

不传入此参数时，查询默认模块数据
parameters.name: function_block_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ThingModelJson.description_en: The feature definitions of the Thing Specification Language model. For more information about the data format of the ThingModelJson value, see [ThingModelJson data description]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150457.html）
ThingModelJson.description_zh: 物模型的功能定义。ThingModelJson取值的数据格式说明，请参见[ThingModelJson数据说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150457.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
